name: roots
description: Mozilla's trust anchors for TLS servers from NSS's certdata.txt at a release tag (MPL 2.0), with Mozilla's distrust-after dates and Chrome's announced distrusts of roots Mozilla still trusts, embedded as PEM and loaded into an x509::Store, with the name constraints Firefox imposes on TUBITAK's root, with Mozilla's OneCRL revocations (intermediates and roots refused anywhere on a path), and policy(): that distrust alone, to lay over the system's anchors or screen a path the system verified; scripts/roots-gen.py rebuilds the file from a newer tag.
